name: Artificer
flavorText: Masters of invention, artificers use ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects. They see magic as a complex system waiting to be decoded and then harnessed in their spells and inventions.

tools: one type of artisan's tools of your choice
skills: Choose two from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.description: You learn how to invest a spark of magic into mundane objects. You can touch a Tiny nonmagical object as an action and give it one of the following magical properties: sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius, emits a recorded message, continuously emits an odor or sound, or displays a static visual effect. The property lasts indefinitely. You can affect a maximum number of objects equal to your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You've studied the workings of magic and how to cast spells, channeling the magic through objects. You must have a spellcasting focus (thieves' tools or artisan's tools) in hand when you cast spells. You know 2 cantrips. You prepare spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your artificer level, rounded down (minimum of one spell).

features.name: Infuse Item
features.description: You've gained the ability to imbue mundane items with certain magical infusions. When you gain this feature, pick 4 artificer infusions to learn. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch a nonmagical object and imbue it with one of your artificer infusions. You can infuse a number of items shown in the Infused Items column.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.description: You've learned how to produce exactly the tool you need: with thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, you can magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. This creation requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work.

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.description: You choose the type of specialist you are: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist, or Battle Smith. Your choice grants you features at 5th level and again at 9th and 15th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20.

features.name: Artificer Specialist Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: Your proficiency bonus is now doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Artificer Specialist Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. If you craft a magic item with a rarity of common or uncommon, it takes you a quarter of the normal time, and it costs you half as much of the usual gold.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one simple or martial weapon or one item that you can use as a spellcasting focus, and you store a spell in it, choosing a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the artificer spell list that requires 1 action to cast. While holding the object, a creature can take an action to produce the spell's effect from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier. The spell stays in the object until it's been used a number of times equal to twice your Intelligence modifier (minimum of twice).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.description: You can attune to up to five magic items at once. You ignore all class, race, spell and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.

features.name: Artificer Specialist Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: You can attune up to six magic items at once.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws per magic item you are currently attuned to. If you're reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to end one of your artificer infusions, causing you to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
